newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Nine killed as Pakistan train crushes school van.
newsitem.headline: Nine killed as Pakistan train crushes school van.

text.p: A Pakistani express train crushed a school van at an unmanned level crossing near Islamabad on Tuesday, killing nine people, including six school children and two teachers, the railways department said.
The van, whose driver also died, was taking the children and their teachers to a school at Gujarhan, 60 km (37 miles) south of Islamabad, the railways department said in a statement.
Six school children and a female teacher were seriously injured in the collision, the statement said. It blamed the van driver for crashing his vehicle into the Quetta Express.
